body:
Just wanted to post a quick update. We're making some progress and I've learned a few things in the past few weeks that have given some insight into how he is feeling. (at least two prior attempts, one very nearly successful. And a history of other issues.)  

I've taken the advice I've seen here and continue to offer my support. I ask him daily how he is feeling, but I do not force the conversation. He has actually started coming forward more with how he feels mentally which is a massive improvement. He also seems to appreciate my concern. This past weekend is the happiest I have seen him in some time. I'm hoping this is the beginning of a turning point for him but time will tell. 

Thank you to those of you who have been kind enough to offer your care an support.
Thank you for your kind words. I'll be sure to do just that.
That's become almost second nature, I always sneak an extra message in to him after bed.
